The season began on 31 July 2026.{{cite web |url=https://spfl.co.uk/news/spfl-fixtures-for-202627 |title=SPFL Fixtures for 2026/27 |publisher=SPFL |date=18 June 2026 |access-date=18 June 2026}} Twelve teams are contesting the league: [[Aberdeen F.C.|Aberdeen]], [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]], [[Dundee F.C.|Dundee]], [[Dundee United F.C.|Dundee United]], [[Falkirk F.C.|Falkirk]], [[Heart of Midlothian F.C.|Heart of Midlothian]], [[Hibernian F.C.|Hibernian]], [[Kilmarnock F.C.|Kilmarnock]], [[Motherwell F.C.|Motherwell]], [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]], [[St Johnstone F.C.|St Johnstone]] and [[St Mirren F.C.|St Mirren]]. ==Teams== The following teams changed division after the 2025–26 season. Reedijk tells Easter Road fans what they can expect from 'brave' team|date=24 September 2026|access-date=24 September 2026}} |24 September 2026 |} ==Format== In the initial phase of the season, the 12 teams will play a round-robin tournament whereby each team plays each one of the other teams three times. After 33 games, the league splits into two sections of six teams, with each team playing each other in that section once. The league attempts to balance the fixture list so that teams in the same section play each other twice at home and twice away, but sometimes this is impossible.
